extracted.intended_audience: general readers, TV viewers, critics, and researchers interested in the television series 'Hacks'
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and measures used to evaluate a half-hour comedy television series (as exemplified by the Wikipedia 'Hacks' page), including critical-aggregation metrics, performance/writing/directing categories, and award nomination/win categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rotten Tomatoes approval rating / critical consensus
rubrics_metrics.description: Approval rating reported on Rotten Tomatoes for each season and an associated critics' consensus statement (e.g., Season 1: 'A prickling debut that pulls few punches, Hacks deftly balances its sharp critiques of the comedy world with more intimate moments…').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an aggregate measure of critical approval; page includes season-by-season approval percentages and concise critics' consensus blurbs describing strengths such as balance of satire and intimate moments, lead performance, and chemistry between leads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metacritic weighted average score
rubrics_metrics.description: Weighted average score on Metacritic for each season (e.g., Season 1 score 82/100).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a numeric indicator of overall critical reception using weighted averages; the page reports season-level Metacritic scores and number of critic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance of satire and intimacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Critics' praise for the show 'deftly balances its sharp critiques of the comedy world with more intimate moments.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether a comedy successfully mixes broader industry/genre satire with character-focused, intimate storytelling; noted in Rotten Tomatoes consensus for Season 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead performance quality (Outstanding Lead Actress / Best Actress)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition of the leading actor's performance (examples: Jean Smart wins/nomination entries such as 'Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series' and 'Best Actress in a Television Series – Musical or Comedy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses range, scene-stealing ability, suitability of role to actor's talents; repeatedly cited across awards and critic consensus as a central pillar of the series' acclaim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting performance quality (Supporting Actor/Actress)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of supporting cast performances (e.g., nominations/wins for 'Outstanding Supporting Actor/Actress in a Comedy Series', 'Best Supporting Actress in a Streaming Series, Comedy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how well secondary characters enhance the series' tone, comedic beats, and character dynamics; reflected by multiple nominations/wins for supporting actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chemistry and central relationship development
rubrics_metrics.description: Critics highlight the central pair's friendship/partnership (e.g., Season 2 consensus: 'finds novel ways to deepen the central pair's lovable friendship').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates how the relationship between leads is developed across episodes/seasons and whether it drives emotional and comedic payoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series pacing and joke quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical commentary on pacing and the consistency/quality of jokes (e.g., Season 5 consensus: 'keeps the pace and jokes right on par with its previous installments').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures episode-to-episode rhythm, setup/payoff of jokes, and ability to maintain comedic momentum through a season or series finale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Longevity / persuasive argument for continuing the show
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical admiration when a season 'makes a persuasive argument for its own longevity.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether the series evolves in ways that justify additional seasons and sustain viewer interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing quality (Outstanding Writing / Best Written TV Show)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition of writing through award categories such as 'Outstanding Writing for a Comedy Series', 'Best Written TV Show', 'Comedy Series' (Writers Guild), and episodic writing awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates originality, joke construction, character arcs, and narrative structure; multiple wins/nominations highlight writing as a key evaluative axis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directing quality (Outstanding Directorial Achievement / Best Directing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award categories including 'Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Comedy Series' and 'Best Directing in a Streaming Series, Comedy'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses creative staging, pacing, performances management, and visual storytelling that enhance comedic and dramatic beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Production design / art direction
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories such as 'Excellence in Production Design for a Half Hour Single-Camera Television Series' and 'Outstanding Production Design for a Narrative Program (Half-Hour)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates sets, locations, props, and overall visual environment supporting tone and world-building of a comedy series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Casting (Outstanding Achievement in Casting / Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognition for casting professionals (e.g., Artios Awards, Emmys 'Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges the appropriateness of actor selection, ensemble chemistry, and casting choices' contribution to the series' success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cinematography (Outstanding Achievement in Cinematography / Outstanding Cinematography)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards such as 'Outstanding Achievement in Cinematography in an Episode of a Half-Hour Television Series' and 'Outstanding Cinematography for a Single-Camera Series (Half-Hour)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates lighting, camera movement, framing, and visual style appropriate to a half-hour single-camera comedy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costume design (Outstanding Contemporary Costumes / Costume Designers Guild awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition via 'Outstanding Contemporary Costumes' and Costume Designers Guild nominations/wins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses how wardrobe supports character, period, tone, and comedic beats (e.g., notable designer credits and wins listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Make-up & hair styling
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories like 'Best Contemporary Make-Up in a Television Series' and 'Best Contemporary Hair Styling in a Television Series'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates makeup and haircraft's role in character realization and visual coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sound mixing and sound editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards such as 'Outstanding Achievement in Sound Mixing for Television Series – Half Hour' and 'Outstanding Achievement in Sound Editing – 1/2 Hour – Comedy or Drama'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures clarity, balance, and creative use of sound to support comedic timing and production quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture editing (single-camera picture editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories like 'Outstanding Single-Camera Picture Editing for a Comedy Series' and related Creative Arts Emmy nominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses rhythm, timing for jokes, and narrative clarity achieved through editing choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Music supervision
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition such as 'Outstanding Music Supervision' nomination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates song selection and use of music to heighten emotional beats and comedic moments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest performance categories (Outstanding Guest Actor/Actress)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards for guest performances (e.g., 'Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series', 'Outstanding Guest Actor in a Comedy Series').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses impact and memorability of single-episode or recurring guest appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensemble performance (Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble)
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories like 'Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Comedy Series' (Screen Actors Guild).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates overall cast cohesion and collective performance strength rather than single-star turns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming / platform-specific recognition (Best Streaming Series, Comedy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards that specifically evaluate streaming programming (e.g., 'Best Streaming Series, Comedy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers how the series performs in the streaming ecosystem: release model, audience engagement, and platform impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakthrough / new series recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards for newcomers such as 'Breakthrough Series – Short Format' and 'Outstanding New TV Series'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses freshness, innovation, and immediate impact of a new show in its debut season.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-level honors (Program of the Year / Top 10 Programs of the Year)
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level accolades like 'Program of the Year' (Television Critics Association) and AFI 'Top 10 Programs of the Year'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates cultural impact, critical consensus, and overall excellence across the television landscape.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry-specific critics'/guilds' categories (e.g., Television Critics Association Outstanding Achievement in Comedy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer or critic-group recognitions such as 'Outstanding Achievement in Comedy' (TCA) and guild-specific prizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflects judgments by specialized bodies (critics, writers, directors) that may prioritize different aspects (innovation, craft, writing, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Episodic awards (Episodic Comedy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition for individual episodes (Writers Guild 'Episodic Comedy' winners/nominations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates single-episode storytelling, standalone script strength, and episodic craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical praise language as evaluative signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Phrases used by critics (e.g., 'prickling debut', 'sterling sophomore season', 'roars back with a fresh set') that signal qualitative strengths like tone, novelty, and rebounding quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpreting critics' adjectives can be used as criteria: originality of tone, confident season-over-season storytelling, and freshness of production elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre-specific achievement (Outstanding Achievement in Comedy / Best TV Comedy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards and nominations explicitly for comedy achievement (e.g., 'Outstanding Achievement in Comedy', 'Best TV Comedy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures success within the comedy genre: consistent humor, comedic innovation, and contribution to television comedy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation and LGBTQ recognition (Best LGBTQ TV Show / GLAAD nominations/wins)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accolades acknowledging LGBTQ representation and themes (e.g., GLAAD nominations/wins; Dorian Awards 'Best LGBTQ TV Show').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates authenticity, sensitivity, and impact of LGBTQ storylines and character portrayals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry craft categories (set decor / production decorating)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set-decor and design awards such as 'Best Achievement in Decor/Design of a Half-Hour Single-Camera Series' (Set Decorators Society).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses the detail, coherence, and contribution of physical set elements to storytelling and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival/critics' special mentions (Peabody Awards 'Entertainment')
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors like the Peabody Award category (e.g., 'Entertainment') recognizing storytelling excellence and societal contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents broader cultural or ethical significance and exceptional storytelling beyond genre-specific craftsmanship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award-category breadth as a measure of overall quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The show's presence across many distinct award categories (acting, writing, directing, technical) as reported on the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A program earning nominations/wins across diverse categories signals comprehensive excellence across craft, performance, and production.
